sophie_support: FYI escalation from @jason_cust — customer sees bursty 502s and timeouts hitting /v1/rerank under heavy load (started ~12:07 PDT).

jason_cust: Confirming. After our promo we spiked to ~220 qps to rerank with batches of 60-64 candidates. Most requests succeed but ~15-20% return 502 or just hang until client retries and then we get 504.

sophie_support: They sent sample payload and timings — attached below. They say this started after they increased batch size.

jason_cust: sample payload:
```json
{"query":"find best product","candidates":["..." x 64],"top_k":5}
```
rough cadence: sustained for 30s, then back to normal, repeat. p95 on their side ~1.2s during spike.

raj_sre: looking at infra metrics now. I'm seeing gateway p95 jump from ~160ms to ~1.1s at 12:07, and an uptick in backend 5xxs. There are retry spikes too — looks like clients are retrying aggressively.

lina_backend: logs show rerank workers reporting OOM-ish stalls and some request handlers hitting request timeout (internal 10s). KV-cache hits drop during the surge. Could be memory-pressure from large batches + concurrent KV cache population.

raj_sre: Also noticing a retry storm from the gateway: failed requests get retried immediately which amplifies backend load. Circuit-breaker thresholds start tripping and we return 502 from the gateway.

ryan_oncall: For mitigation, suggest temporary per-API-client concurrency cap + throttle their rate. Can we add a short-term internal route rule to cap concurrency for that customer?

lina_backend: We can patch a per-customer limit on the gateway side. Also can enable fallback to a smaller-model variant (lower memory) per routing policy so large batches hit a lighter model.

raj_sre: Quick triage steps I've done:
- confirmed KV cache miss rate increases at spike start
- bumped worker pool on dedicated cluster by +15% (no roll yet, warm up ongoing)
- temporarily disabled automatic immediate retries at gateway for that route

sophie_support: Customer asks for repro steps we ran so they can validate once we apply mitigations. Can we provide a minimal repro they can run?

lina_backend: Repro recommended: keep qps ~200, candidate batch size 60-64, set client retry to 0 or linear backoff. Run for 2 minutes. Example load command:
```bash
ab -n 12000 -c 200 -p payload.json -T application/json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
This should reproduce the latency climb and KV-cache churn.

jason_cust: We'll run a controlled repro tomorrow morning and can temporarily reduce batch size if needed. Would appreciate guidance on client-side backoff config.

raj_sre: Recommend exponential backoff with full jitter, max 3 retries, and cap concurrency. That stops retry amplification.

ryan_oncall: Action items:
- lina_backend: deploy temporary per-customer concurrency cap + model-fallback rule (ETA 25m)
- raj_sre: monitor gateway retry rate, KV cache hit ratio, and p95; roll back if regressions (ETA 10m for monitoring dashboards)
- sophie_support: communicate mitigation plan to @jason_cust and ask for repro window

sophie_support: Noting customer priority: P1 for them since it impacts live campaign. Will coordinate post-mitigation check. :pray:

deploy-bot: Deployment started: gateway-route-update (per-customer-cap) by lina_backend. Change-id: d5f3b1.

lina_backend: Patch in place. Gateway now rejects requests over 40 concurrent for that API key with 429. Also added model-fallback routing on high-memory pressure.

raj_sre: Early signals: retry rate down 70%, backend 5xx down 80%, p95 trending back to ~200-300ms. KV-cache hit ratio improving.

jason_cust: Saw immediate improvement on our end. Still watching but error rate dropped a lot. Thanks.

sophie_support: I'll close this thread once customer confirms stable for 24h. Recording follow-ups: consider longer-term fixes — smarter batching suggestions in docs, autoscaling K/V cache memory, and a per-tenant admission control feature.

ryan_oncall: Logging follow-up ticket for infra: INFRA-2147 - investigate KV-cache prefetch and GC tail for large-batch workloads.

sophie_support: closing provisional triage. Will reopen if customer reports recurrence. :white_check_mark:
